name: agent-monitor
description: Mobile-friendly local-first monitor and control surface for Claude Code, Codex, and other tmux-based agent sessions. 面向手机端的本地优先 Agent 监控与控制工具。

scripts.build:mac: cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project AgentMonitorApple.xcodeproj -scheme AgentMonitorMac -destination 'platform=macOS' build
scripts.build:ios: cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace AgentMonitorApple.xcworkspace -scheme AgentMonitoriOS -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' build
